tool: WebSearch tool available to the executing Claude agent in a claude.ai cloud session. General web search engine, US-only, 'standard' or 'extended' mode. Each call returns result titles and URLs only (at most about ten), no total hit count, no abstracts, no pagination control and no documented ranking or personalization settings.
transcription: Titles and URLs are transcribed exactly as the tool returned them, in returned order. Some returned titles are page labels, hostnames or URL fragments rather than bibliographic titles; they are kept unchanged. No result was added from memory.
clock: Times are readings of the workspace shell clock (UTC) taken immediately before and after each batch; individual calls were not separately timestamped. Batch windows are therefore bounds, not per-query run times.
